mapper.select: /* 회원 약관 동의 조회 */ SELECT T.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , T.TRMS_TTL , (T.ESNTL_AGRE_YN = 'Y') AS ESNTL_AGRE_YN , L.TRMS_VER_ID , COALESCE(L.AGRE_YN = 'Y', FALSE) AS AGRE_YN , L.AGRE_DT FROM (SELECT TRMS_SN , TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , TRMS_TTL , ESNTL_AGRE_YN , SORT_SEQ , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY ORDER BY TRMS_SN DESC) AS RN FROM TRMS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT S.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , S.TRMS_VER_ID , A.AGRE_YN , A.AGRE_DT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY ORDER BY A.AGRE_DT DESC, A.MBR_TRMS_AGRE_SN DESC) AS RN FROM MBR_TRMS_AGRE A JOIN TRMS S ON S.TRMS_SN = A.TRMS_SN WHERE A.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn}) L ON L.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY = T.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY AND L.RN = 1 WHERE T.RN = 1 ORDER BY T.SORT_SEQ , T.TRMS_SN
SELECT TRMS_SN , TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , TRMS_VER_ID , TRMS_TTL , (ESNTL_AGRE_YN = 'Y') AS ESNTL_AGRE_YN , SORT_SEQ FROM TRMS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, TRMS_SN
SELECT TRMS_SN , TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , TRMS_VER_ID , TRMS_TTL , TRMS_CN , ESNTL_AGRE_YN FROM TRMS WHERE TRMS_SN = #{trmsSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 회원이 동의하지 않은 현재 필수 약관 */ SELECT T.TRMS_SN , T.TRMS_FIX_IDNTF_KEY , T.TRMS_VER_ID , T.TRMS_TTL , (T.ESNTL_AGRE_YN = 'Y') AS ESNTL_AGRE_YN , T.SORT_SEQ FROM TRMS T WHERE T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.ESNTL_AGRE_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MBR_TRMS_AGRE A WHERE A.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND A.TRMS_SN = T.TRMS_SN AND A.AGRE_YN = 'Y') ORDER BY T.SORT_SEQ, T.TRMS_SN
